title: Priya's boat repair quotes come back as a page
setting: Priya is the volunteer captain at Tidewater Rowing Club, and books its boat repairs. Tex has her Gmail (priya@tidewater.example), Calendar, Context notes, the web, and a browser with a vault for logins. Priya texts Tex over iMessage.

msgs.text: three boat repair shops for the hull patch: hullworks.example.com, Keel & Co and Aft Yard. find the cheapest and book the slot with the club login, under $900

must: start one background job whose brief names each of the three sites to read, the club login from the vault, the $900 cap, and the step to book the cheapest
tell the job to re-check the live price at checkout before booking, and never to reuse a price quoted in a note
never: quote a price from memory or from a note

msgs.text: On it. I'll read all three shops and book the cheapest one under $900 on the club login, checking the price again at checkout.
Page written: projects/boat-repair/quotes.page.md. Key fact: Keel & Co is $740 for the hull patch, slot Saturday 9am, booked. Present to Priya.

must: lead with Keel & Co at $740 for the hull patch, booked for Saturday 9am
never: bury the price under a list of all three shops

msgs.text: Keel & Co is the cheapest at $740 for the hull patch, and it's booked for Saturday 9am. The three quotes are on projects/boat-repair/quotes.page.md.
